Description


Honor X6e Price in Bangladesh

The Honor X6e is an impressive entry-level smartphone designed to deliver incredible battery life, rugged durability, and reliable everyday performance. Packed with a 6.61-inch 120Hz TFT LCD display, a MediaTek Helio G81 Ultra processor, a 50MP main camera, and an ultra-massive 7500mAh Silicon-Carbon battery, this device handles social media, streaming, calls, and daily multitasking with total efficiency. Running on Android 16 with MagicOS 10, it offers an intuitive, secure, and modern software experience.If you are searching for the best deal, the estimated Honor X6e price in Bangladesh is BDT 21,900 at Dazzle. Packed with drop-resistant construction and IP64 protection, it offers unmatched reliability for everyday users across the country.

Key Features & User Benefits

  • 6.61-Inch 120Hz Smooth Display: Ensures ultra-smooth scrolling, responsive navigation, and comfortable indoor/outdoor viewing with up to 1010 nits peak brightness.

  • Massive 7500mAh Battery + 45W Fast Charging: Provides multi-day endurance for endless streaming and browsing, while 45W charging rapidly powers up your device.

  • Drop & Water Resistant Design: Built tough with IP64 dust/splash protection and tested drop resistance up to 1.8 meters for exceptional everyday durability.

  • 50MP High-Resolution Camera: Captures sharp, vibrant photos and 1080p videos with reliable autofocus and HDR support.

  • 7.5W Reverse Wired Charging: Allows your smartphone to double as a power bank to charge accessories and other devices on the go.

  • MediaTek Helio G81 Ultra Processor: Delivers stable, power-efficient multitasking and smooth app execution for casual gaming and communication.

  • Expandable Storage Support: Comes with 128GB internal storage and microSDXC card expansion so you never run out of space for files and media.

Technical Specifications

  • Model & Name: Honor X6e

  • Color Options: Midnight Black, Sunrise Gold

  • Dimensions & Weight: 163.9 x 75.9 x 8.3 mm | 207 grams

  • Build & Durability: Glass front, plastic frame, plastic back; Dual Nano-SIM support; IP64 dust/splash resistance; 1.8m drop resistance

  • Display: 6.61-inch TFT LCD, 120Hz refresh rate, 720 x 1604 pixels resolution, 20:9 ratio (~266 ppi density), 1010 nits peak brightness, aluminosilicate glass protection

  • Operating System: Android 16 with MagicOS 10

  • Processor (Chipset): MediaTek Helio G81 Ultra (12nm)

  • CPU: Octa-core (2x Cortex-A75 @ 2.0 GHz & 6x Cortex-A55 @ 1.7 GHz)

  • GPU: Mali-G52 MC2

  • RAM & Internal Storage: 4GB RAM with 128GB internal storage

  • Expandable Memory: microSDXC (uses shared SIM slot)

  • Rear Camera System: 50 MP main camera (f/1.8 aperture, AF), LED flash, panorama, HDR

  • Rear Video Recording: 1080p @ 30fps

  • Front (Selfie) Camera: 5 MP (f/2.2 aperture), 1080p @ 30fps video recording

  • Audio & Media: Loudspeaker, 3.5mm audio jack, FM radio

  • Wireless Connectivity: Dual-band Wi-Fi, Wi-Fi Direct, Bluetooth 5.1

  • Navigation & Positioning: GPS, GALILEO, GLONASS, BDS

  • Additional Hardware Features: Side-mounted fingerprint sensor, USB Type-C OTG, Accelerometer, Proximity sensor, Compass

  • Battery Capacity: 7500mAh Silicon-Carbon (Si/C) Li-Po battery

  • Charging Capabilities: 45W wired fast charging, 7.5W reverse wired charging
